name: Yushu Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Yushu Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of consumer- and industry-class general-purpose legged and humanoid robots. The company offers humanoid robots, robotic arms, perception systems, and components, such as bionic robot joint motors and super robot waterproof joints.
